test_title: PYST 04: SSC JE CE - General Intelligence (Held on 06 Jun 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
M, O, N, S, T, E, and R are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (not necessarily in the same order). O sits to the immediate right of M. M sits second to the right of S. E sits third to the left of S. T sits second to the right of R.

Who are the immediate neighbours of N?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) O sits to the immediate right of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/149f238ffe49aaa00cc78498daf038e0baa1362a3fda003f171f22ccebdd2ef8.png] 

2) M sits second to the right of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b26fc819e4f671b6d821bdf4df77c985a763ea0177664cf957076ea2441540b0.png] 

3) E sits third to the left of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b225773f26f0e3ded262cff4aef0029abbd21c0763264e0ddfa412ed0a6711b.png] 

4) T sits second to the right of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c19f5204341516f6d0588aa83755d1615c0b26ad59818cb5f8cd51e42f62195.png] 

Here, we can see that the immediate neighbours of N are 'E and R'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"****E and R"**.
